scope: Exact attainable interval endpoints from a complete fixed-prefix binary image propagated to the cut; full-three-rank sorting obstruction with precisely two layers remaining.
reviewed_claims: For threshold k, a real value has rank below k exactly when its thresholded bit is zero. Thus lo(c)>=k iff all cut bits from complete k-zero inputs equal one; hi(c)<k iff all such bits equal zero.
Existing forward clauses L=>state and U=>not-state combined with the new reverse conjunction clauses define both endpoint predicates exactly.

Weights are preserved by the fixed prefix, so deduplicating its complete image retains every distinct symbolic continuation relevant to each threshold. Sampling or merely representing each weight would be insufficient.
Boundary values at k=0,n are already constants with the correct truth values. Only interior thresholds need converse clauses.
The full-triple clause negates all twelve literals defining three exact equalities lo=a and hi=a+2: each row contributes not L[a], L[a+1], not U[a+3], U[a+2].

Both synthesis call sites use the complete prefix_images result and simulate all free layers up to the cut before adding exact endpoints. The generic worker requires cap=4, hence precisely two remaining layers.

The hand theorem uses actual attainable sets and permutation conservation, then an isolated four-wire cone component and redundant fixed-extreme comparisons. No adjacent-last-layer or perfect-matching assumption enters this theorem.
control_review: Checker compares exact supports from all real orders with complete binary threshold runs, tests every alternative interval on each wire, and directly checks the twelve-literal forbidden-triple condition. Row-separability makes the one-wire variations sufficient for endpoint uniqueness on those fixed networks.
optional_sat_replay_improvement: On any future SAT survivor, compare assigned endpoint predicates with the recomputed exact endpoints and directly assert absence of a full triple. Current survivor replay verifies capacity, but this omission does not affect UNSAT soundness.
